statement: For every arr1 and arr2 satisfying the preconditions, max_abs_val_expr arr1 arr2 returns a result r (it does not fail), and r is the maximum of the set of all values |arr1[i] - arr1[j]| + |arr2[i] - arr2[j]| + |i - j| with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n. Equivalently, every such expression is at most r, and some such expression is exactly r.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr1). The preconditions are: len(arr2) = n; 2 <= n <= 40000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, -1000000 <= arr1[i] <= 1000000 and -1000000 <= arr2[i] <= 1000000.
